name: Tiger Balm White Pain Relief Ointment - 19g - Made in Thailand
description:
Product details of Tiger Balm White Pain Relief Ointment - 19g (Made in Thailand)

Product Type: Tiger Balm White Extra Strength Herbal Ointment (Big Jar)

Uses: Effective relief for muscle and joint pain, back pain, abdominal pain, stiffness, and cramps.

Benefits:

Provides quick and soothing relief from aches and pains

Natural herbal ingredients for safe and effective results

Easy to apply over large areas of the body

Helps relax sore muscles and joints

Application: Apply gently and massage over affected areas for relief from pain and tension.

Origin: High-quality product of Tiger Balm, Thailand.
